Name: Modular Zen Garden Walkability Patch
Author: CozyPsychologist
Description:
A simple patch for Modular Zen Gardens Furniture by Leroymilo that allows players to walk on the sand.

Features
[list]
[*]Walk freely across zen garden sand.[/*]
[*]Stones, trees, statues, and other decorations retain their collision.[/*]
[*]Supports all garden sizes and seasonal appearances.[/*]
[*]Works with Stardew Valley 1.6.[/*]
[/list]Requirements
[list]
[*]SMAPI[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22140]Modular Zen Gardens Furniture[/url][/*]
[/list]Installation
[list=1]
[*]Install the original Modular Zen Garden mod.[/*]
[*]Extract this patch into your Stardew Valley mods folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game and enjoy your walkable zen gardens![/*]
[/list]Credits
All original garden artwork and functionality belong to Leroymilo. This patch only allows the player to walk on the sand.
